# Brand Name

> Junk removal across the Portland metro and Clark County, Washington, based in Gresham, Oregon. Customers snap a photo or tap what is going, see a flat price by load size with travel for their ZIP already included, and book online. We do all the lifting, loading and hauling.

## What we do

- One-time hauls, from a single item to a full truck: furniture, mattresses, appliances, TVs and electronics, carpet, yard debris, hot tubs, and garage, basement and estate cleanouts.
- Monthly pickups at a set load size for landlords, property managers and businesses; a three month prepay saves 10%.
- Photo quotes: up to four photos, the items are counted for the customer, and the truck on the page fills.
- If there is more on the day than the photos showed, the customer sees the new price before anything is loaded.
- We can't take paint, chemicals, fuel, asbestos or medical waste.

## Prices and travel

The price is set by how much of the truck a load fills, plus a travel fee by zone: rings of road miles from our base in Gresham, with no travel charge close to Gresham. The current prices and zones are on the homepage and in the quote; the quote always shows the full price before booking.

## Where we work

Gresham, Portland, Troutdale, Fairview, Wood Village, Happy Valley, Clackamas, Damascus, Boring, Milwaukie, Gladstone, Oregon City, West Linn, Lake Oswego, Tigard, Tualatin, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Sherwood, Wilsonville, Sandy and more in Oregon; Vancouver, Camas, Washougal, Battle Ground and Ridgefield in Washington.
